name: Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.card_interval
statement:
lemma Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.card_interval {n : ℕ} (x y : ℕ) (hy : y ≤ n) :
    #{a : Fin n | ↑a ∈ Finset.Ico x y} = #(.Ico x y)

name: Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.card_rectPtSet
statement:
@[simp] lemma Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.card_rectPtSet (n a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℕ) (h : b₁ ≤ n ∧ b₂ ≤ n) :
    #(rectPtset n a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂) = (b₁ - a₁) * (b₂ - a₂)

name: Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.card_rectPtsetSubsetMatrix

theorem Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.density_by_cols_ub {n c : ℕ} (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)

name: Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.density_def
statement:
lemma Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.density_def {n : ℕ} (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel M] :
    density M = #{(i, j) : Fin n × Fin n | M i j}

name: Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.density_le_ex_of_not_contains
statement:
lemma Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.density_le_ex_of_not_contains (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) (AvoidP : ¬ Contains P M) :
    density M ≤ ex P n

name: Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.density_mk_mem_product
statement:
lemma Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.density_mk_mem_product {n : ℕ} (I J : Finset (Fin n)) :
    density (fun i j ↦ (i, j) ∈ I ×ˢ J) = #I * #J

name: Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.density_mono
statement:
@[gcongr] lemma Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.density_mono {M N : Fin m → Fin n → Prop} (h : ∀ i j, M i j → N i j) :
    density M ≤ density N

name: Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.ex_le_iff
statement:
theorem Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.ex_le_iff {P : α → β → Prop} {m n : ℕ} :
    ex P n ≤ m ↔ ∀ (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop), ¬ Contains P M → density M ≤ m

name: Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.ex_le_sq
statement: lemma Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.ex_le_sq {P : α → β → Prop} (n : ℕ) : ex P n ≤ n ^ 2

name: Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.ex_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.ex_zero (P : α → β → Prop) : ex P 0 = 0

name: Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.exists_av_and_ex_eq
statement:
lemma Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.exists_av_and_ex_eq {n : ℕ} {P : α → β → Prop} (P_nonempty : ∃ a b, P a b) :
    ∃ M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop, ¬ Contains P M ∧ ex P n = density M

name: Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.le_ex_iff
statement:
theorem Tengoku.ForbiddenMatrix.le_ex_iff (P : α → β → Prop) (P_nonempty : ∃ a b, P a b) {m n : ℕ} :
    m ≤ ex P n ↔ ∃ (M : Fin n → Fin n → Prop), ¬ Contains P M ∧ m ≤ density M

name: Fin.natCast_val_eq_zmodFinEquiv
statement:
